{"sourceType":"TED","sourceAuthority":"European Border and Coast Guard Agency","authority":"European Border and Coast Guard Agency (Frontex)","reference":"fb3d33fd-fb15-43f3-8b10-82353d6a002d","title":"Shipborne VTOL UAS deployment with data fusion and integration services","description":"The surveillance of the EU’s land and sea borders is a fundamental component of the European integrated Border Management (EIBM) as identified by the Multiannual Strategic Policy for EIBM 2023-2027 . Border surveillance requires effective operational measures taken by Frontex and Member States’ border management authorities. The Technical and Operational Strategy for EIBM states that these measures should be intelligence-driven and risk-based, drawing on multi-domain sensor networks.
